One sentence, one real result.

All from one project: LinHiêu, an app to translate and listen to books. Every shape is a real Figma layer you can drag, edit and build on.

  1. Screen

    “Draw a bilingual reader: original on the left, translation on the right, a listening bar below”

    The paragraph being read lights up on both sides

  2. ERD

    “Draw an ERD for books, chapters, glossary and users”

    Primary and foreign keys, crow’s foot notation

  3. Sequence

    “Draw the sequence for translating, then listening to a chapter”

    The out-of-quota branch is there, not silently dropped

  4. Userflow

    “Draw the userflow for running out of translations: trial, monthly plan, own key”

    Error paths in red; each box links to its screen

  5. State

    “Draw the states of a chapter”

    Stuck, failed, translated: each state its own colour

  6. Activity

    “Draw the chapter translation process by role”

    Swimlanes: reader, app, queue, AI provider

  7. Sitemap

    “Draw a sitemap for the book app”

    The page tree, area by area

Questions

What do I need?
A Mac with macOS 13 or later or a Windows 10 / 11 PC, the Figma desktop app (the free plan works) and a supported AI, such as Claude Code, Cursor or Codex.
Do my Figma files leave my computer?
No.
Does it work offline?
Up to 30 days.
What happens after 12 months?
It keeps working.
How do I pay?
Bank transfer by QR code, with a company invoice if you need one.
Can I get my money back?
Yes.
